title: feat(ofk2): out-face same-k holds at k=2: t=6 vs t=10
science: omega same-k at k=2 on B_8: t(2,0,0)=6, t(2,2,2)=10, 108>100; t(8,0,0)=24, t(3,2,0)=11 (9 under rho3). Independently re-derives the mid-leave vacuity of 6902 as a side lemma (mid_leave_hits = 0), which is the strongest form of that no-go in the band.
